# ToolGarden — llms.txt

> A free collection of browser-local tools for JSON, images, PDFs, audio, text, QR codes, subtitles, and documents. Tool inputs are processed on the device and are not uploaded to a ToolGarden processing server.

## What is ToolGarden?

ToolGarden provides practical browser-based utilities for developer data, documents, and media. Supported workflows use browser APIs, JavaScript, Web Workers, WebAssembly, and locally executed models to reduce unnecessary upload exposure. Page analytics are separate from tool processing and are described in the Privacy Policy.

<!-- registry-tools:start -->
## Registry Tool Index

> Generated from `lib/tools/registry.ts` and `messages/*.json` during `npm run build`.

### Format / 格式化

- **JSON Formatter / JSON 格式化** (`/json-format`): Free online JSON / JSONC / JSON5 formatter to format, minify, and validate data with comments, trailing commas, tree view, and node operations
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/json-format
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/json-format
- **JSON Escape / JSON 压缩转义** (`/json-escape`): Free online JSON escape tool to minify and escape JSON / JSONC / JSON5 for embedding in strings, or unescape back
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/json-escape
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/json-escape
- **JSON Repair / Clean / JSON 修复清洗** (`/json-repair`): Free online JSONC / JSON5 repair tool for comments, trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, and other common JSON issues
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/json-repair
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/json-repair
- **JSON Diff / JSON 对比** (`/json-diff`): Free online JSON / JSONC / JSON5 diff tool to visually compare two documents, highlighting additions, removals, and changes
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/json-diff
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/json-diff
- **File Preview / 文件预览** (`/file-preview`): Preview images, documents, spreadsheets, PDFs, text, media, and ZIP entries locally in your browser without uploading files.
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/file-preview
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/file-preview
- **Text Diff / 文本对比** (`/text/diff`): Free online text diff using an open-source diff algorithm to highlight line and word changes
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/text/diff
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/text/diff
- **Whiteboard / 白板工具** (`/other/whiteboard`): Create a full local whiteboard with tldraw, including shapes, drawing, notes, images, pages, and export
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/other/whiteboard
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/other/whiteboard
- **Quickdraw Whiteboard / Quickdraw白板** (`/other/quickdraw-whiteboard`): Create an infinite-canvas whiteboard with open-source Quickdraw, including pen, highlighter, shapes, text, notes, images, export, and fullscreen presenting
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/other/quickdraw-whiteboard
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/other/quickdraw-whiteboard

- **Image to AVIF** (`/image/to-avif`): Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG, and other images to AVIF locally in the browser.
- **Image to Base64** (`/image/to-base64`): Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG, AVIF, and other images to Base64 Data URLs locally in the browser with file selection, drag-and-drop, and clipboard paste support.
- **Base64 to Image** (`/image/base64-to-image`): Restore image Base64 strings or `data:image` Data URLs into previewable downloadable image files locally in the browser.
- **Image Crop** (`/image/crop`): Crop images with a draggable frame locally in the browser.
- **Image Resize** (`/image/resize`): Resize full images at a proportional target width or height locally in the browser.
- **Audio Tools** (`/audio`): Browse browser-local audio conversion, extraction, merge, trim, compression, recording, and transcription tools.
- **Audio to MP3** (`/audio/to-mp3`): Convert WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, OPUS, WebM, FLAC, and other audio files to MP3 locally in the browser with ffmpeg.wasm; FFmpeg core assets download on demand.
- **Audio to WAV** (`/audio/to-wav`): Convert common audio files to WAV locally in the browser.
- **Extract Audio** (`/audio/extract`): Extract an MP3 audio track from MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI, MPEG, and other video files.
- **Audio Merge** (`/audio/merge`): Merge multiple audio files into one MP3 locally in the browser.
- **Audio Trim** (`/audio/trim`): Cut audio by start and end time and export MP3.
- **Audio Compressor** (`/audio/compress`): Reduce audio size by lowering MP3 bitrate.
- **Voice Recorder** (`/audio/recorder`): Record from the microphone in the browser, preview locally, and export MP3.
- **Audio to Text** (`/audio/to-text`): Transcribe uploaded audio with a browser-loaded open-source Whisper model.
- **PDF Tools** (`/pdf`): Browse PDF conversion and document tools.
- **Convert to PDF** (`/pdf/to-pdf`): Convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint, EPUB, MOBI, JPG, PNG, WebP, TXT, Markdown, and HTML to PDF. The first release runs locally in the browser for docx, xlsx/xls, pptx, EPUB, unencrypted legacy MOBI/PalmDOC, images, and text-based formats.
- **PDF to Word** (`/pdf/to-word`): Extract text from text-based PDF files locally in the browser and generate editable Word DOCX documents.
- **Merge PDF** (`/pdf/merge`): Combine multiple PDF files into one document with drag-and-drop reordering.
- **Split PDF** (`/pdf/split`): Split one PDF into multiple documents by page ranges or export every page as a separate PDF.
- **Extract Pages** (`/pdf/extract-pages`): Extract selected pages or ranges from a PDF and save them as a new document.
- **Organize PDF** (`/pdf/organize`): Reorder, duplicate, and delete PDF pages before exporting a new document.
- **Subtitle Maker** (`/subtitle-maker`): Free online LRC and SRT subtitle editor with media preview, timeline calibration, and local subtitle export.
- **JSON Schema Generator** (`/json-schema`): Generate JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) from a JSON sample, with automatic format detection.
- **JSON Schema Validator** (`/json-schema-validate`): Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema and report error paths with explanations.
- **JSONPath Query** (`/json-path`): Extract nested data using JSONPath expressions (e.g. `$.store.books[*].title`).
- **JSON Stats** (`/json-stats`): Analyze JSON structure: nesting depth, key counts, type distribution, and size comparison.
- **Info Encoder / Decoder** (`/info-codec`): Encode, decode, hash, and parse text with Unicode, URL, UTF16, Base64, MD5, SHA1, hex, JWT, Cookie, Gzip, HTML entity, and string escape operations.
- **QR Code Generator** (`/qr-code/generate`): Generate QR code PNG files from URLs, text, contact data, or Wi-Fi configuration text.
- **QR Code Decoder** (`/qr-code/decode`): Decode uploaded QR images or scan QR codes from the camera locally in the browser and copy the decoded text.
- **JWT Parser** (`/jwt`): Decode JWT tokens to inspect Header and Payload; verify HS256 signatures using the Web Crypto API.

## Languages

- English: `/en/...` (default)
- Chinese (Simplified): `/zh/...`
- Blog articles: `/en/blog/...` and `/zh/blog/...`

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4
- i18n via next-intl
- Supported tool processing is client-side; page analytics are disclosed separately in the Privacy Policy
- Image compression and conversion use browser APIs such as Worker, OffscreenCanvas, ImageBitmap, and Canvas when available
- A locale preference cookie may be used for language routing; page-level analytics may be used, but tool inputs are not uploaded
- Static export hardened with security headers and reduced build artifacts

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- All tools are free with no account required
- Tool input data is not uploaded to the server, which helps protect privacy-sensitive content
- Supports JSON5-like syntax (unquoted keys, single quotes) in the formatter
- JWT verification uses the browser's built-in Web Crypto API (HS256 only)
- Excel support via SheetJS (xlsx library)
- YAML support via the `yaml` npm package
- XML support via fast-xml-parser
- Image tools support editing, compression, upscaling, ID photo making, background removal, AI watermark selection repair, conversion, Base64 image encode/decode, crop, resize, JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG, AVIF, drag-and-drop, clipboard paste, preview comparison, and ZIP batch download
- Audio tools use ffmpeg.wasm for browser-local conversion, video audio extraction, merge, trim, compression, and recording export; audio-to-text can load an open-source Whisper model through Transformers.js
- PDF tools use pdf-lib for PDF generation and page-level PDF operations, pdfjs-dist for PDF text extraction, fflate for Office OpenXML/EPUB/DOCX packaging, SheetJS for spreadsheets, a PalmDOC text extractor for legacy MOBI, and browser Canvas for Unicode text rendering
- Subtitle Maker supports LRC and SRT parsing, editing, timing calibration against local audio/video, and export without uploading files
- Info Encoder / Decoder supports Unicode, URL, UTF16-style hex escapes, Base64, MD5, SHA1, hex, JWT decoding, Cookie formatting, Gzip decompression, HTML entity decoding, URL parameter parsing, and string escaping locally in the browser
- QR Code Generator uses qrcode for PNG generation; QR Code Decoder uses jsQR for browser-local image decoding
